- ENT symptoms (as applicable): None reported (no throat swelling/closing, dysphagia/odynophagia, nasal/ocular symptoms, stridor, etc.).

  - No conflicting statements that require explicit note beyond the need for labs to clarify thyroid function and overall health. (Conflict noted: none.)

  - After results, you will receive a text message to book an appointment.
  - If you are feeling poorly, do not wait for results—contact us again.
  - If you need to report, use the app: there is an “oh three hundred” number listed in the app to call support.

- Escalation criteria/red flags:

- Follow-up plan:
  - Review blood test results and determine next steps (possible physical exam if indicated).
